title: Bariatric & Weight Loss Surgery in India
headline: Achieve Long-Term Weight Loss & Better Health with World-Class Bariatric Surgeons in India
introduction: India is one of the top destinations for bariatric surgery, offering advanced weight loss treatments at affordable prices. Bariatric surgery not only helps reduce excess weight but also improves or resolves obesity-related conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, sleep apnea, and joint pain.

categories.name: Restrictive Procedures
procedures: Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy – removes a portion of the stomach to reduce appetite
Adjustable Gastric Banding (Lap-Band Surgery) – silicone band placed to limit food intake

categories.name: Malabsorptive Procedures
procedures: Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass (RYGB) – reduces stomach size & alters digestion to limit calorie absorption
Mini Gastric Bypass (MGB / One Anastomosis Gastric Bypass) – shorter, simpler bypass procedure

categories.name: Combination / Advanced Procedures
procedures: Biliopancreatic Diversion with Duodenal Switch (BPD/DS) – most effective for morbid obesity
Robotic Bariatric Surgery – precision surgery with faster recovery
Revisional Bariatric Surgery – for failed or complicated previous surgeries

why_choose_india: Globally trained bariatric surgeons with 20–30 years of expertise
Success rates over 95% with long-term weight management
Affordable packages – save 70–80% compared to USA/UK/UAE
Robotic & laparoscopic options for minimal scarring & faster healing

success_rates.Improved fertility & hormonal balance: Better quality of life & long-term survival
